title: COMPUTE TRIO INGEST — coralReef + barraCuda + toadStool = THE REAL ENGINE's GPU
source: Kevin's diagram: wgpu → Vulkan/DX12/Metal/WebGPU → every gate
philosophy: That diagram IS the coralReef and barraCuda target for zk ingest to primals. The sovereign compute stack IS the Real Engine's GPU layer.

the_diagram.what_kevin_saw: wgpu sits on top of Vulkan (Linux), DX12 (Win), Metal (macOS), WebGPU (Browser) — each gate mapped below
the_diagram.what_it_means: This is NOT just a rendering abstraction. This is the COMPUTE FABRIC. barraCuda's 859 WGSL shaders execute through this exact stack. coralReef compiles them to native GPU binary. toadStool dispatches them to the right hardware. The rendering AND the compute AND the AI all flow through ONE pipeline.
the_diagram.the_inversion_applies_here: When we invert rendering (backscatter + epitope sort), we FREE this entire compute fabric for science, AI, and game simulation. The same WGSL shaders that render also compute physics, run lattice QCD, train neural nets, and process OSINT.

barracuda.role: WHAT to compute — sovereign math library
capabilities: linalg: LU, QR, SVD, Cholesky, eigensolvers, sparse CSR SpMV
special: erf, gamma, beta, Bessel, Legendre, Hermite, Laguerre
numerical: gradients, integration, ODE (RK4 parallel), Hessian
spectral: Anderson localization, Lanczos, tridiagonal eigensolve
stats: bootstrap, correlation, regression, distributions, histogram
ops: matmul, softmax, element-wise, reductions, FHE (NTT/INTT)
tensor: GPU tensor type, buffer management, memory layout
physics: deformed gradient, lattice SU(3) HMC, Higgs U(1)
bio: Smith-Waterman, phylogenetics, HMM, pangenome, UniFrac, dN/dS
ml: ESN reservoir update, batch fitness evaluation
nn: activations (gelu, selu, swish, softplus, celu, elu), dropout
lattice: SU(3) momentum/link update, fermion force, pseudofermion
barracuda.shader_dispatch: ShaderDispatch trait — one interface, GPU or CPU. WGSL is the single source of truth for all math.
barracuda.the_insight: barraCuda doesn't just do rendering math. It does ALL math. The same GPU that renders games also solves differential equations, runs molecular dynamics, trains neural nets, and computes lattice QCD. ONE fabric.

coralreef.role: HOW to compile — sovereign shader compiler
coralreef.stats: 3,967 tests, zero clippy warnings, zero unsafe, AGPL
coralreef.pipeline: WGSL/SPIR-V/GLSL → naga frontend → SSA IR → lower_f64 → optimize → legalize → register alloc → encode → native GPU binary
coralreef.what_it_replaces: NVIDIA's proprietary compiler (nvcc). AMD's proprietary compiler (amdgpu-pro). ALL vendor shader compilers.
coralreef.pure_rust: Zero unsafe. Zero vendor SDK. Pure Rust all the way down.
coralreef.the_insight: coralReef means Gaia compiles her own GPU code. No NVIDIA compiler. No AMD compiler. Sovereign all the way to the silicon.

toadstool.role: WHERE to dispatch — hardware orchestration + fractal enumeration
toadstool.capabilities: Multi-framework routing, hardware fingerprinting, adaptive workgroup tuning, multi-node distribution
toadstool.fractal_pattern: Same tree-walk discovers LAN gates AND PCIe GPU subsystems AND NPU NP mesh topology
toadstool.dispatch_chain: toadStool discovers hardware → coralReef compiles shader → barraCuda executes math → result flows back through the trio

zk_ingest_to_primals.what: Zero-knowledge proof integration — bearDog signs the compute, rhizoCrypt stores the proof, loamSpine certificates the result
zk_ingest_to_primals.why: Every GPU computation should be PROVABLE. When barraCuda runs a lattice QCD simulation, the result should carry a ZK proof that the computation was correct.

the_chain.1_dispatch: toadStool routes work to best gate/GPU
the_chain.4_sign: bearDog signs the result with BLAKE3
the_chain.5_store: rhizoCrypt encrypts and stores in DAG
the_chain.7_anchor: Optional: BTC/ETH anchor for public proof

per_gate.eastgate_vulkan: RTX 4070 via Vulkan (Linux) — 73 TFLOPS + Akida NPU

inversion_applied_to_compute_trio.traditional: Render frame → read back to CPU → send to AI → read back result → render next frame. Serial. Wasteful.
inversion_applied_to_compute_trio.inverted: Scene tree epitope sort (NPU) → backscatter only changed pixels (RT cores) → freed compute runs AI/physics/science simultaneously (CUDA+tensor cores) → results flow through the same wgpu fabric. ALL PARALLEL.

what_changes.barracuda_shaders: The same 859 WGSL shaders work for BOTH rendering math AND scientific compute. The inversion just changes the SCHEDULING — more time for science, less for rendering.
what_changes.coralreef_compiler: Compiles the SAME shaders to SAME native binaries. The inversion is transparent to the compiler.
what_changes.toadstool_dispatch: toadStool's fractal enumeration now also schedules based on VALUE TRIADS — high granularity routes more work to tensor cores, high focus routes to specific domains.

what_the_5090_really_does.coralreef_compilation: Sovereign compilation to native SM120 binary
what_the_5090_really_does.all_simultaneously: All of the above, ALL AT ONCE, on ONE GPU
